description: context-bench task corpus (docs/plans/falsifiability.md B1-1). Committed form of the ×10 tokenomics falsifiability gate (coding-agent-excellence.md §0/§7 gate 6). Each task's ground_truth was derived by direct grep/read of the fathom and agentic-kit repos at the commit noted in `source` — reproducible by anyone, not by querying the live fathom daemon (see internal/contextbench/task.go doc comment for the full convention). Run artifacts (raw claude -p transcripts, scored results, summary tables) are NOT committed here — they land under workspace/artifacts/context-bench/ per scripts/context-bench.sh.
